{{short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date = September 2017}} {{Use Indian English|date = September 2017}} {{GeoGroup|article=Category:Ahmedabad Metro stations}} {{update|date=December 2024}} This is a list of all stations of the '''[[Ahmedabad Metro]]''', a [[rapid transit]] system serving [[Ahmedabad]], India. Ahmedabad Metro is the [[List of metro systems|12th]] metro system in India. It was built and is operated by the [[Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited]]. Its first section was inaugurated on 4 March 2019{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/infrastructure/pm-narendra-modi-inaugurates-ahmedabad-metro-first-phase-takes-a-ride-1551707985388.html|title=PM Narendra Modi inaugurates Ahmedabad Metro first phase, takes a ride|date=2019-03-04|website=livemint.com|language=en|access-date=2019-03-08}} and opened to the public on 6 March 2019, with the East-West Corridor.{{Cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/ahmedabad-metro-to-open-for-public-on-wednesday/articleshow/68263112.cms|title=Ahmedabad Metro to open for public on
